Heatbit just launched Bitwater, an $899 element that screws into your existing electric water heater and mines Bitcoin while it heats the tank 🚀

It has 20 mining chips and runs up to 34 TH/s on 600 watts. Decrypt estimates about $1.25 of BTC per day at full power. Preorders ship in Q1 2027 🔥

Bitcoin won back its 50-week moving average in September, and six weekly closes later it still hasn’t retested the line 👀

Price sits about 5% above it, with the line near $76,000. In 2015, 2019 and 2023, the line held twice when it got retested. ✊
